items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe reports no exploitation in the wild yet, but Sansec reproduced four attack routes within 24 hours.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, also known as PolyShell, allows for arbitrary code execution due to an unrestricted file upload. CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on October 27, 2026, indicating active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This out-of-band security update addresses a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers remote code execution via improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including six exploitable without authentication, that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Discovered in August 2025, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution. Sansec observed mass attacks exploiting SessionReaper starting October 22, 2026, despite an emergency fix released by Adobe in early September 2025.

items.title: Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization Flaw
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of the August 2026 patch set, is an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) that could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years
items.summary: CosmicSting, also known as CVE-2024-34102, is a critical vulnerability that Sansec observes is actively being exploited, with stores getting hacked at a rate of 5 to 30 per hour as of September 2026.
